headline: Recommended up to $581,997 for Training Ground Prop, with a forcible entry door and added roof features.
summary: The higher cost covers a forcible entry door, four more rope anchor points on the roof, and a rope edge protector. Fire leaders also reviewed the FY28 budget, which City Hall asked be built as close to 5% as possible without benefits. The overall proposed increase is 7.0%, but 5.378% is needed for contractual and standard operating increases.
decisions: Recommended funding for the Training Ground Prop, not to exceed $581,997; motion carried.

  Training Ground Prop 
Update on new dollar amount for the Training Ground Prop 
 Added a forcible entry door, as well as 4 more rope anchor points to the roof for rappelling 
and added a rope edge protector to the roof so the quote amount changed. 
 
Motion by Commissioner Lambert in full support and recommend funding for the dollar amount 
not to exceed $581,997 
Seconded by Commissioner Kelly 
MOTION CARRIED
Page 2 of 2 
 
26  FY28 Budget Discussion  
 
Chief Buxton and Business Manager Karen Conde informed the commission City Hall 
administration has requested we do a budget exercise to get as close to 5% as we can, without 
benefits. They discussed the following: 
 Utilities and fuel costs have gone up significantly. 
 Concerns about our current payroll and member anniversary dates, a blended rate will now 
be used. 
 Looking to bring back two positions 
o R2 – Lieutenant of Training/Safety 
o Community Risk Reduction Officer in the Fire Marshal Division 
 Looking to build back up the Building & Grounds account as suggested by the Capital 
Improvements Committee 
 Overtime lines need to be increased 
 Overall increase is 7.0% but would need 5.378% for contractual obligations and standard 
operating increases. 
 To cut 2% we would lose the two re-instated positions, the buildings & grounds account, 
addition to HVAC account, and little increases in various operating accounts. 
 The mayor is supposed to provide FY28 Budget Guidelines on 12/01/2026. 
 There will be plenty of time to have more conversation and make adjustments for the FY28 
Budget.
